_: This repository's own declared quality gates — the checks it already runs, declared at their CURRENT measured values on 2026-09-15 (S20, the quality-ratchet slice) so the ratchet starts where the repo is. Held by starter-kit/quality_ratchet.py --precommit, chained into .githooks/pre-commit: a commit that lowers any `min` below, raises any `max`, or removes a gate is refused; tightening and adding pass. Loosening is a plan-mode decision in its own commit with the reason in CHANGELOG.md, committed with --no-verify (SAFEGUARDS.md Blast Radius Limits). Measure with `python3 starter-kit/quality_ratchet.py --run` (about three minutes: it runs bin/tests.sh) and cite the summary line in the close-out receipt (HANDOFFS.md, runtime_smoke); bin/check-handoff lints for it.
_first_tightening_owed: `tests-sh-failed` (max 0) is deliberately NOT declared yet: on the feature branch Test 9 fails by construction (`--source=github` reads main, which lacks the new starter-kit files) and a gate that is red at declaration teaches bypass on day one. Add it in the first commit after this branch merges, when bin/tests.sh reads 128/0 on main.
